result.prior_version_note: The cap itself predates the current period, but the documents do not say when the Rent Ordinance's increase limits first applied. Earlier documented rates: 1.4% for March 1, 2025 – February 28, 2026 (D080, D083) and 1.7% for March 1, 2024 – February 28, 2025 (D083). D080 also refers to a complete list of past annual allowable increases that is not included here.
